critical_code_review_comments: server.py one-shot migration (lines 215-243) is well-structured and idempotent — but it's a pure legacy-key rewrite, so it cannot add a category that was never there. Any seed data-shape change (like adding Diesel to salishmarinaservices) must happen in the seed layer OR via an explicit per-handle $set in the migration.

seed_router.py / demo_seed.py seeding is idempotent and only skips existing docs, so updating a listing's category list requires either dropping the doc or an explicit update statement. Consider adding a 'seed_version' field so seeds can replay $set when they bump.

The missing demo-wash-n-go handle is not defined anywhere in /app/backend (grep for 'wash' returned 0 hits). The iter88 report assumed it should exist — either (a) add it to demo_seed, or (b) update the iter88 test file to drop the wash-n-go assertion if it's not an intended profile.

/app/mobile/.env EXPO_PACKAGER_PROXY_URL correctly points at the -1 preview; the un-prefixed host (boat-community.expo.preview.emergentagent.com) is a different, stale preview. This should be flagged in docs because trailing confusion will recur.

Dark-mode theme storage key is NOT 'theme' in localStorage (LS_KEYS was [] after setting theme), so pre-seeding dark via playwright is non-trivial. Add a URL query like ?theme=dark or a stable storage key to make dark-mode QA easier.
